# BUG-068 probe: how Drizzle 0.30.10 + postgres.js store a jsonb object (scratch PostgreSQL 16.15, 2026-10-19)

Generated by `scripts/poc-event-insight/probe-jsonb-encoding.ts`. "string" means the object was stored as JSON text inside a jsonb string (what production shows). `customJsonb` is the helper already used for the three `unprocessed_scraper_payloads` columns and the decided fix for the other 27. The last two lines rehearse the order: old writer, fixed writer (customJsonb), then the migration statement.

```
default (prepare: true)            | drizzle jsonb: string  | text param ::jsonb: string  | client.json(): object
prepare: false (pooler setting)    | drizzle jsonb: string  | text param ::jsonb: string  | client.json(): object
prepare: false + max_lifetime      | drizzle jsonb: string  | text param ::jsonb: string  | client.json(): object
prepare: true + json passthrough   | drizzle jsonb: object  | text param ::jsonb: object  | client.json(): n/a
prepare: false + json passthrough  | drizzle jsonb: object  | text param ::jsonb: object  | client.json(): n/a

prepare: false (as shipped)        | customJsonb (schema.ts helper): object
prepare: false + json passthrough  | customJsonb (schema.ts helper): ERROR: The "string" argument must be of type string or an instance 

after the fix, before migration    | stored type/SQL ->> read: string/null, object/-7.7       | Drizzle read (city): Yogyakarta, Yogyakarta
after the migration statement      | stored type/SQL ->> read: object/-7.7, object/-7.7       | Drizzle read (city): Yogyakarta, Yogyakarta
```
